reason: The only available action forms the metal into a tray for the nursery.
expectation: I expect a shaped nursery tray that can be lined and filled.

effect: The shallow tray is ready to prepare for growing.
reaction: The result is as expected; forming it is straightforward.
reason: The only combination lines the tray, making a suitable growing container.
expectation: I expect a lined nursery tray ready for the granules.

effect: The tray is lined and ready for growing medium.
reaction: It is a predictable assembly step.
reason: The only combination puts clean granules into the lined tray to support the roots.
expectation: I expect a filled nursery tray ready for watering or sowing.

effect: The tray now has a root medium; the wick is the next available addition.
reaction: It follows naturally, though the sequence is very directed.
reason: The wick can draw liquid to the medium without a pump, matching the passive nursery goal.
expectation: I expect a wick-equipped tray that can be connected to the nutrient reservoir.

effect: The wick is installed, so the tray can now be supplied from the reservoir.
reaction: Reusing the earlier wick feels like a useful continuation of the storm solution.
reason: The only offered action connects the wick-equipped tray to the nutrient supply.
expectation: I expect the tray to receive nutrient solution through the wick and complete the passive nursery.

effect: The passive nursery is watered and complete; it is ready for the next crop.
reaction: Finishing the watering setup is satisfying, although the menu leaves no real choice.
reason: Sowing the lettuce in the prepared tray directly starts the next crop.
expectation: I expect a sown nursery tray and the remaining goal to be completed.

effect: The seeds complete the nursery, and the visible rising moisture confirms the wick is working without its own pump.
reaction: The slow dark line is a pleasing concrete image linking the new crop to the storm survival setup.

mostWorthwhile.text: Sowing the nursery and seeing the dark line rise through the felt made the passive watering idea tangible and tied it back to the storm.

leastWorthwhile.text: Forming, lining and filling the tray were sensible but predictable consecutive assembly steps with only one gameplay option each.

surprise.text: The final image of water rising through felt made the passive mechanism more vivid, though the wick's purpose was already signaled.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; each part contributed to the tray or its water supply, although the single-option sequence made decisions feel prescribed.

continue.text: I would continue to see what happens with the preserved discovery and the journey home, though this chapter's straightforward nursery assembly alone did not offer much puzzle challenge.
